title: Only 3 Apps Stay Plain TV: Every New App Needs the Bonus | vitalii.no
description:
App classification across the TV stick, phone, and home-PC bridge used an allow-list of gated apps, where anything not explicitly listed defaulted to free plain TV. That meant every time one of my boys installed a new streaming or video app, it silently counted as free time until I noticed and added it to the gate list myself — which happened more than once.

I flipped the logic to default-deny: a short allow-list of plain apps, plus a neutral list for launcher and settings screens, and everything else is now classified as requiring the bonus. I applied this identically across all four copies of the classification logic, covering the TV stick, the phone and the home-PC bridge scripts, so no platform could drift out of sync on its own.

Any new app the boys install now needs the bonus by default instead of slipping through as free time, and the rule lives identically in four codebases at once, so there's no longer a platform where it can quietly fall out of date.
